style.vernacular: Imo State capital in Igbo rain-forest country, largely rebuilt after the civil war: 1-3 storey cream, white and pastel painted-render houses and shops with rust-red or green long-span metal roofs, pillared porches and balustraded balconies on the larger Igbo-style storey houses, bare laterite soil at roadsides, and an unusually green, hotel- and nightlife-rich centre.
style.ornament: Pillared porches with balustrades and upper balconies on prosperous houses; painted murals and uli-style geometric patterns on walls; large concrete mission churches (Catholic cathedral with dome and paired octagonal towers); statues and roundabout monuments; roadside fence walls and gates.
